description: team add/modify every option/join/leave/list/empty/remove and team members on scoreboards; results stored into a probe chest; a pig and a player as members.

actions.command: setblock 0 -60 0 minecraft:chest
item replace block 0 -60 0 container.0 with minecraft:paper
summon minecraft:pig 2.5 -60 2.5 {NoAI:1b,Tags:["p"]}
execute store result storage t:p a1 int 1 run team add red
execute store result storage t:p a2 int 1 run team add blue {"text":"Blue","color":"blue"}

execute store result storage t:p a4 int 1 run team list
